findings.title: Capture the implementation inventory after lazy input imports
findings.evidence: The new producer calls implementation() at line111, before load_inputs() at line121. noise_pilot_io.py:32-40 inventories only modules already present in sys.modules. The actual path is attempts/0020/pilot_inputs.py:29-35 -> qe_response_bundle.py:208-209 -> qe_response_schema.validate_bundle; that last module is imported only while loading the bundles. The complete pilot-002/result.json implementation list at lines25-991 contains qe_response_bundle.py and qe_response_fft.py but no qe_response_schema.py; the source inventory and corrected launch admission also contain no binding for it. This is an executed project consumer, not an optional dependency: qe_response_schema.py:97-104 enforces native k/partner/spin identity and the FD reference convention. Consequently the saved implementation receipt omits the bytes of an actual input-admission consumer. The early snapshot was introduced with the new driver in efbeb40c.

Preserve pilot-002 and its existing hashes; append a narrowly scoped provenance correction identifying the original executed validator from defensible existing source evidence, or explicitly retain that provenance limitation if the original identity cannot be established.
